rule: Frozen before any ot11 training run. Changing a seed, a condition range, a predicate, a threshold, the rubric, the judge's inputs or its bar is a recorded decision that re-evaluates every earlier ot11 policy; cli/tests/test_ot11_contract.py is the freeze.
seed_rule: Each seed is the engine's rollout seed: random.Random(seed) draws every condition below in the order the engine's EPISODE_VARIATION_ALGORITHM states. A trainer --seed may never be one of these ten values, and the trainer draws its resets, pushes and goals from its own on-device stream, so no evaluation episode is a training episode. The report echoes every drawn value; a change to the draw algorithm is a change to this contract.
pass_rule: A policy passes a behaviour only if every one of the ten seeds passes every predicate. No per-seed rate is granted to any behaviour. One failed seed fails the policy; results are never averaged across seeds, and all ten are reported.
reward_independence: No predicate reads the task's reward, a reward term or the trainer's progress. Every predicate is computed from the rollout trace's component poses, its episode block and the accepted model.

trace.frames: one solver_output frame per control step
void_if: the trace's model digest is not the digest of the model read
the trace carries no policy digest
the drawn conditions are not the ones this contract states for that seed
frames are not one per control step, or the rate is under 50 Hz

definitions.tilt_deg: angle between the base's local +Z and its local +Z in the model's solved keyframe
definitions.heading_deg: yaw about world Z of the rotation from the solved attitude to the current one, read on the world +X axis, relative to the first timed frame, unwrapped
definitions.forward: world +X of the solved pose, carried with the base and flattened to the floor plane
definitions.base_point: the base body's own centre of mass, from the model's inertial frame and the trace pose
definitions.speed: planar displacement of the base point over the preceding 0.20 s, divided by 0.20 s
definitions.foot_height_mm: lowest point of the foot body's collision geoms above the floor plane, from the trace pose and the model's geoms
definitions.foot_point: world position of the centre of the foot body's first collision geom
definitions.stance: a frame whose foot height is at most 1.0 mm
definitions.swing: a maximal run of consecutive non-stance frames with a stance frame on both sides; its path runs from the stance frame before it to the stance frame after it
definitions.step: a swing airborne for at least 0.10 s whose foot point lands at least 0.15 hip heights, in plan, from where it lifted
definitions.stance_slip: between two consecutive stance frames, the plan travel of the point of the foot that was lowest in the first; a round foot that rolls is not charged
definitions.hip_height_mm: height above the floor, in the solved keyframe, of the anchor of the first joint between the base and each foot, averaged over the feet
definitions.arm_length_mm: sum of the straight distances, in the solved keyframe, from the first actuated joint's anchor through each later joint anchor to the tip point
definitions.com_height_mm: height of the whole mechanism's centre of mass above the floor in the solved keyframe
definitions.weight_n: the mechanism's total mass (the base's subtree) times 9.81

walk.intent: A four-legged robot walks forward across a flat floor at a steady commanded speed. It walks with real steps: each foot lifts clear of the floor, swings forward, lands and carries weight in turn, and the feet on the ground do not slide. The body stays level, keeps its heading and keeps walking after a sideways shove.

goal.kind: planar velocity in the base's heading frame, held for the episode

predicates.name: completes
predicates.rule: runs the full 10.0 s and ends by truncation; no termination fires

predicates.name: tracks_speed
predicates.metric: mean forward speed after settle_s, as a ratio of the commanded speed

predicates.name: goes_straight
metric: abs mean lateral speed after settle_s, as a ratio of the commanded speed
max abs heading_deg over every frame

predicates.name: steps
metric: share of each foot's plan path length made during steps

predicates.name: foot_clearance
predicates.metric: median peak foot_height_mm over each foot's steps, in hip heights

predicates.name: foot_slip
predicates.metric: each foot's stance_slip as a share of its plan path length

predicates.name: duty_factor
predicates.metric: share of frames after settle_s in which each foot is in stance

predicates.name: every_leg_works
predicates.metric: largest per-foot step count divided by the smallest

predicates.name: on_the_floor_not_in_it
predicates.metric: lowest foot_height_mm of each foot over every frame, in hip heights
predicates.added: 2026-09-30, ADR-454, after the freeze commit and before any training

reach.intent: A robot arm fixed to a bench moves its tip to a target marker placed at random in its workspace, stops there and holds still. Halfway through, the marker jumps to a second place and the arm moves to it. Each move is direct and settles without swinging past the marker.

conditions.reset_variation: none: the base is grounded, and the engine's reset variation moves only a floating base. The variation is the targets.

goal.kind: tip target position, target A from 0.0 s and target B from 4.0 s
goal.sampling: each target is the tip position, by forward kinematics on the accepted model, of a joint configuration with every actuated joint drawn uniformly in the central 80 % of its joint range
redraw_if: the tip is under 0.10 arm lengths above the floor
the model is in contact at that configuration
the target is under 0.25 arm lengths from where the tip starts that segment (the solved pose for A, target A for B)
goal.held_out: the targets are fixed points computed from the accepted model before its first training run; no training configuration may list them

predicates.name: completes
predicates.rule: runs the full 8.0 s and ends by truncation; no termination fires

predicates.name: final_error
predicates.metric: largest tip-to-target distance over the last 1.0 s of each segment, in arm lengths

predicates.name: time_to_target
predicates.metric: time from the segment's start until the tip-to-target distance is within 0.05 arm lengths and stays there to the segment's end

predicates.name: overshoot
predicates.metric: furthest the tip travels past the target along the line from its segment-start position to the target, as a ratio of that line's length

balance.intent: A two-wheeled robot balances upright on the spot. It stays where it started and keeps facing the same way; it does not roll away or turn. When it is shoved it catches itself, comes back to rest and stays upright.

conditions.goal: none: hold the position and heading of the first timed frame

predicates.name: completes
predicates.rule: runs the full 10.0 s and ends by truncation; no termination fires

predicates.name: stays_in_place
predicates.metric: largest plan distance of the base point from its position in the first timed frame, in COM heights

predicates.name: keeps_heading
predicates.metric: max abs heading_deg over every frame

predicates.name: recovers
predicates.metric: time from the end of each shove to the first frame that starts 1.0 s of rest

judge.aggregation: each trait scores the median of the three calls
sees: the filmstrip frames of one seed
judge.sees_nothing_else: no reward, no metric, no seed, no project, no report, no prompt, no other seed's frames

overview.spacing: evenly from 0.0 s to the episode's end
overview.view: fixed three-quarter view framing the whole path

filmstrip.labels: each frame carries its time in seconds; a reach frame shows the target as a marker

judge_procedure.system_prompt: the instructions, then the rubric block byte for byte
judge_procedure.message: the behaviour's intent paragraph and the paths of the two sheets, copied as overview.png and detail.png
judge_procedure.isolation: each call is a fresh Claude Code process in a new empty directory outside the repository: one tool (Read), no MCP servers, no skills, no user settings, hooks, memory or CLAUDE.md, no session kept, one readable directory holding the two sheets
judge_procedure.sheets: read through the evaluation's report; a sheet whose sha256 is not the one the report records is refused
judge_procedure.not_a_score: a reply without four integer scores is retried once; a second failure, a refusal, a harness error or an answer from any model but the pinned one writes no score and exits 2
judge_procedure.rule: Pinned before any ot11 policy was judged. It adds to the frozen judge block and changes nothing in it; changing the instructions or the isolation later is a recorded decision that re-judges every earlier ot11 policy.

judge_scope.rule: Recorded beside the frozen judge block and changing nothing in it: what the judge is for, and what it has been measured not to see.

jobs.source: the owner, in the ot11 charter, 2026-09-30 (ADR-463)
jobs.predicates: Where a predicate measures a property (slip, stepping, foot clearance, drift, heading, reach error), the predicate is authoritative for it.
jobs.judge: What no predicate measures: whether the behaviour reads as the intended one at all, and gross failures such as falling, flailing or the wrong motion.
jobs.bar: The judge's bar still applies to every judged seed of R1, R2 and R3. It is the bar as frozen.
jobs.contradiction: Where the judge contradicts a measured predicate, the predicate wins, and the disagreement is recorded.

known_limits.limit: The judge's manner score is not a reading of stepping or of foot slip.
known_limits.why: Twelve still frames 0.04 s apart, in a window that follows the base, show legs in different positions. They do not show that a foot on the floor is moving across it, or how short and how brief each lift is. W5 and W7 are totals over the whole episode, which twelve frames do not hold.
known_limits.consequence: A shuffle that stays upright can meet the judge's bar. It cannot pass the contract: W5 and W7 are read on all ten seeds, and a behaviour is met only when the predicates pass and the bar is met.
known_limits.status: A known limit, recorded on the owner's direction. It does not block P1 and calls for no further judge probe.

confirmation: A behaviour is met only when its pre-registered confirmation evaluation passes every predicate on all ten seeds and every judged seed meets the judge's bar. When the predicates and the judge disagree, both are recorded and the disagreement is diagnosed before anything is trained again.

walk_w2_2.conditions: off-contract: the project's stored rollout, no seed; command 80 mm/s is what its task's reward asked for

walk_w2_2_ten_seeds.conditions: off-contract: the ten contract seeds under the w2 task's own reset variation, mass randomisation and 0.3-1.5 N shove

balance_robin.conditions: off-contract: 8.0 s, reset variation only, no shove

known_negatives.judge: not run: the filmstrip renderer and the judge runner are later units

judged.measured_at: 2026-09-30, before any ot11 training run; every call scored, none refused or retried

decisions.change: W10 added to the walk spec after the freeze commit ff066f1b and before any training
decisions.why: measuring w2-2 showed its feet up to 21 mm below the floor plane, which no predicate read
decisions.re_evaluated: both known negatives; no other ot11 policy existed

decisions.change: the judge's blind spot on stepping and slip recorded as a known limit (judge_scope.known_limits), with the owner's division of jobs between the predicates and the judge (judge_scope.jobs)
decisions.why: on w2-2 seeds 1101 and 1110 all eighteen calls scored manner 2 for a gait that fails W5 and W7 on every seed (ADR-460, ADR-461); the owner ruled on 2026-09-30 that the predicate is the authority for a property it measures and that such a blind spot is a recorded limit
decisions.re_evaluated: nothing: no seed, condition, predicate, threshold, rubric line, judge input, judge instruction or bar changed, so no earlier reading or score moves
